scope: Port DynamicHlsPlaylistGenerator: build .m3u8 VOD playlists from keyframe/segment timing (consumes hermit-keyframes KeyframeData). Transliterate the Hls.Tests cases. Only the Playlist/ subtree is in scope.
summary: Tiny crate: one public generator (DynamicHlsPlaylistGenerator) with a public CreateMainPlaylist(request) -> String entry point plus three internal timing/extension helpers (ComputeSegments, ComputeEqualLengthSegments, IsExtractionAllowedForFile) and a private keyframe-extraction fan-out (TryExtractKeyframes). The parity oracle (DynamicHlsPlaylistGeneratorTests) ONLY exercises the three internal helpers — pure timing math + extension matching — never CreateMainPlaylist end-to-end and never the extractor plumbing. So the port's tested core is deterministic and dependency-free; the CreateMainPlaylist string assembly and the IKeyframeExtractor fan-out are untested-but-portable glue. There is NO single hermit-traits trait to implement; expose an inherent DynamicHlsPlaylistGenerator API (constructor taking a keyframe-extractor list + a way to read the allowed-extensions config, and a create_main_playlist method).
no_hermit_trait: IDynamicHlsPlaylistGenerator is a 1-method C# DI interface with a single production impl. Per PortJob instruction, do NOT invent a hermit-traits trait; expose DynamicHlsPlaylistGenerator as a concrete public struct with an inherent create_main_playlist(&self, CreateMainPlaylistRequest) -> String. Only introduce a KeyframeExtractor trait *locally in hermit-hls* (see UNIT 3) to model the C# IKeyframeExtractor collection.

ordered_port_plan.name: CreateMainPlaylistRequest + timing helpers (the parity core)
contents: CreateMainPlaylistRequest.cs -> a plain request struct: media_source_id: Option<Uuid>, file_path: String, desired_segment_length_ms: i32, total_runtime_ticks: i64, segment_container: String, endpoint_prefix: String, query_string: String, is_remuxing_video: bool. (Ctor arg order preserved; all fields read-only getters -> pub fields or builder.)

compute_equal_length_segments(desired_segment_length_ms: i32, total_runtime_ticks: i64) -> Result<Vec<f64>>. Ticks math: segment_length_ticks = desired_ms * 10_000 (TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(ms).Ticks = ms*TicksPerMillisecond=10_000). whole = total/segment_length_ticks (integer div), remaining = total % segment_length_ticks. len = whole + (remaining==0?0:1). Fill whole entries with desired_segment_length.total_seconds() = ms/1000.0; if remaining!=0 last = remaining as f64 / 10_000_000.0 (TimeSpan.FromTicks(remaining).TotalSeconds). Return Err(InvalidOperation) when desired_ms==0 OR total_runtime_ticks==0.

compute_segments(keyframe_data: &KeyframeData, desired_segment_length_ms: i32) -> Vec<f64>. If keyframe_ticks non-empty AND total_duration < last keyframe tick, rebind total_duration := last keyframe tick (the overshoot clamp). desired_segment_length_ticks = desired_ms*10_000; running desired_cut_time starts there; last_keyframe=0. For each keyframe tick in order: if tick >= desired_cut_time -> push (tick-last_keyframe) as seconds (ticks/1e7), last_keyframe=tick, desired_cut_time += segment_length_ticks. After loop, remaining = total_duration - last_keyframe; if remaining>0 push remaining as seconds.

is_extraction_allowed_for_file(file_path: &str, allowed_extensions: &[String]) -> bool. Path.GetExtension: take substring from last '.' INCLUDING the dot; empty (no dot / trailing) -> false. Strip leading dot from the file's ext; for each allowed, TrimStart('.') then case-insensitive (OrdinalIgnoreCase / ASCII) equality. NOTE C# GetExtension('testfile')=='' -> false (Invalid test); '/some/.../testfile.mkv' with allowed 'mkv' (no dot) -> true.
Ticks/seconds conversion constant TICKS_PER_SECOND=10_000_000, TICKS_PER_MILLISECOND=10_000 (reuse from hermit-keyframes if re-exported, else local consts).
ordered_port_plan.notes: This unit is the entire parity oracle. Keep the three helpers as free/associated fns (they are `internal static` in C#) so tests call them directly. seconds = ticks as f64 / 1e7 (matches TimeSpan.FromTicks(t).TotalSeconds within f64). ComputeEqualLength total_seconds for whole segments uses ms/1000.0 exactly (test expects 6.0, 3.0, 2.123, 1.234). Watch the [^1] last-element writes.

ordered_port_plan.name: Playlist string assembly (CreateMainPlaylist body) + segment extension helper
contents: get_segment_file_extension(segment_container: &str) -> String: if container is not whitespace-only -> "."+container else ".ts". (Ported inline from EncodingHelper.GetSegmentFileExtension — NOT yet in hermit-mediaencoding; small enough to co-locate here or add to hermit-mediaencoding::encoding_helper and re-use. Prefer adding to hermit-mediaencoding to avoid duplication, but a local helper is acceptable if that crate's API isn't ready.)

The .m3u8 builder from CreateMainPlaylist (lines 49-106): header (#EXTM3U, #EXT-X-PLAYLIST-TYPE:VOD, #EXT-X-VERSION:{7 if .mp4 else 3}, #EXT-X-TARGETDURATION:{ceil(max segment or desired_ms)}, #EXT-X-MEDIA-SEQUENCE:0); optional #EXT-X-MAP for fMP4 (.mp4) init segment; per-segment #EXTINF:{len:.6} , nodesc + URL line ({endpoint_prefix}{index}{ext}{query_string}&runtimeTicks={cumulative}&actualSegmentLengthTicks={lengthTicks}); #EXT-X-ENDLIST.

Formatting fidelity: length formatted "0.000000" (6 decimals, invariant culture -> Rust format!("{:.6}")); lengthTicks = round(length * 10_000_000) as i64 (Convert.ToInt64 = round-half-to-even); currentRuntimeInSeconds accumulates lengthTicks (misnamed in C#: it's ticks). TARGETDURATION uses Math.Ceiling of a double and appends it (C# prints e.g. '11' via double ToString — reproduce integer-looking output; ceil then format).
ordered_port_plan.notes: UNTESTED by the oracle but load-bearing for real use. Reproduce byte-for-byte: AppendLine emits \n (Jellyfin normalizes; C# Environment.NewLine — but tests don't assert this string, so match \n and document). The '&runtimeTicks=0&actualSegmentLengthTicks=0' literal on the MAP line and the ', nodesc' suffix are literal. Math.Ceiling double->string: format as an integer when whole (use ceil then cast/format without decimals to mirror C# double.ToString of an integral value).

ordered_port_plan.name: KeyframeExtractor trait + TryExtractKeyframes fan-out + generator wiring
contents: Local trait KeyframeExtractor (port of Extractors/IKeyframeExtractor.cs, which lives in hermit-keyframes' sibling namespace but is only consumed here): is_metadata_based() -> bool; try_extract_keyframes(item_id: Uuid, file_path: &str) -> Option<KeyframeData>. Define in hermit-hls (the C# type is in the Hls assembly's Extractors namespace, not Keyframes).

DynamicHlsPlaylistGenerator struct: holds Vec<Arc<dyn KeyframeExtractor>> FILTERED to is_metadata_based()==true at construction (mirrors ctor .Where(e => e.IsMetadataBased)), plus access to the allowed-extensions config (EncodingOptions.allow_on_demand_metadata_based_keyframe_extraction_for_extensions from hermit-model; take an IServerConfigurationManager-equivalent from hermit-traits OR accept the Vec<String> directly — prefer a trait/closure so config can be read per-call like C#).
try_extract_keyframes(&self, item_id, file_path) -> Option<KeyframeData>: gate on is_extraction_allowed_for_file(file_path, allowed_exts); then iterate extractors, return first Some.

create_main_playlist(&self, request) -> String: if request.is_remuxing_video && media_source_id.is_some() && try_extract_keyframes(id, &file_path).is_some() -> compute_segments(&kf, desired_ms) else compute_equal_length_segments(desired_ms, total_runtime_ticks) (propagate/expect the InvalidOperation on 0s — C# lets it throw). Then run the UNIT 2 builder.
ordered_port_plan.notes: Untested plumbing. The C# IServerConfigurationManager.GetEncodingOptions() call is a per-invocation config read; model it with a hermit-traits config accessor (e.g. ServerConfigurationManager) or a Fn/closure returning EncodingOptions, so live config changes are honored. Keep the trait object shape (Vec of extractors) to match the DI collection.

The FfProbe/FfTool extraction logic already ported in hermit-keyframes (ff_probe.rs, ff_tool.rs stub) as free functions; Matroska is deferred there (Wave 5 EBML). hermit-hls only needs the KeyframeExtractor TRAIT (UNIT 3) to fan out over injected extractors — concrete impls are supplied by callers/tests, not ported here. No test in Hls.Tests constructs a real extractor.

deferred.name: EncodingHelper.GetSegmentFileExtension (canonical home)
deferred.reason: Not yet present in hermit-mediaencoding::encoding_helper. Trivially ported inline in UNIT 2. If/when hermit-mediaencoding grows this helper, hermit-hls should depend on it instead of keeping a local copy (extract-don't-duplicate). Flagged, not blocking.

deferred.name: CreateMainPlaylist newline/culture exactness
deferred.reason: C# uses StringBuilder.AppendLine (Environment.NewLine) and InvariantCulture double formatting. No test asserts the assembled playlist string, so exact newline bytes are unverified by the oracle. Port with \n and format!("{:.6}") + documented assumption; revisit only if a byte-parity fixture is added.

constants_of_note.name: TICKS_PER_SECOND
constants_of_note.note: 1 tick = 100ns. Load-bearing for every seconds<->ticks conversion in both compute helpers and the EXTINF/actualSegmentLengthTicks output. Fixed .NET semantic encoded by the test expectations — NOT a candidate setting.

constants_of_note.name: TICKS_PER_MILLISECOND
constants_of_note.note: desired_segment_length_ms * 10_000 = segment length in ticks (TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds). Fixed .NET semantic — not a setting.

constants_of_note.name: hls_version_fmp4 / hls_version_ts
constants_of_note.note: HLS protocol versions: 7 for fMP4 (.mp4 segments), 3 otherwise. Spec-mandated literals, not tuning knobs — not a candidate setting.

constants_of_note.name: StringBuilder initial capacity 128
constants_of_note.note: Micro-optimization hint only (new StringBuilder(128)); no behavioral effect. Ignore / use String::with_capacity if desired. Not a setting.

parity_oracle: DynamicHlsPlaylistGeneratorTests — 6 test methods, all targeting the 3 internal static helpers (compute_segments, compute_equal_length_segments, is_extraction_allowed_for_file). NO test covers create_main_playlist or the extractor fan-out. Replicate as rstest #[case] parametrized tests. Use MsToTicks(ms) = ms*10_000 helper in test setup.

cases.exercises: cuts finish before last keyframe; big final remainder
single keyframe at 0 -> whole duration is remainder
empty keyframe list -> whole duration is remainder; overshoot-clamp guard must not index empty list
total_duration(0) < last keyframe -> rebind total to last keyframe tick; single segment
total(9900ms) < last(10000ms) -> clamp to 10000ms; only the 10000 cut fires -> one 10s segment (remaining 0 not pushed)
total < one segment -> single remainder segment
dotless allow entry + full path; TrimStart('.') on allowed

behavioral_constants: compute_equal_length_segments: whole = total/seg_ticks (integer div), remaining = total % seg_ticks; whole segments = desired_ms/1000.0 seconds each; trailing partial = remaining/1e7 seconds; throw on desired_ms==0 || total==0.
compute_segments overshoot clamp: if keyframe_ticks non-empty && total_duration < keyframe_ticks[last], set total_duration = keyframe_ticks[last] before scanning (must guard against empty list).

compute_segments: emit a segment each time a keyframe tick >= running desired_cut_time (advance last_keyframe and desired_cut_time by seg_ticks); append final (total_duration - last_keyframe) only if > 0.
is_extraction_allowed_for_file: false if path has no extension; compare file ext (leading dot stripped) case-insensitively against each allowed entry with its leading dots trimmed.
lengthTicks in playlist = round-half-to-even(length_seconds * 1e7) as i64 (Convert.ToInt64 of double).
hls version = 7 for .mp4 segment ext (fMP4), else 3; fMP4 also emits an #EXT-X-MAP init line.
EXTINF length formatted with exactly 6 decimals, invariant culture.

extractors collection filtered to is_metadata_based()==true at construction; try_extract returns the first extractor that yields data, gated by is_extraction_allowed_for_file against the configured allowed-extensions.
notes_on_existing_crate: crates/hermit-hls currently only has a doc-comment lib.rs and a Cargo.toml already depending on hermit-mediaencoding, hermit-keyframes, hermit-model, hermit-traits, async-trait, tokio, thiserror, rstest. The generator logic is fully synchronous — async-trait/tokio deps are likely unnecessary for this port (the C# CreateMainPlaylist is sync; extraction is sync). Consider dropping async-trait/tokio unless a caller needs an async extractor trait. Add uuid if not already transitive.
